info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Status API provides access to the current status of prescribed medications, enabling users to efficiently track and manage pharmacy orders. Ideal for healthcare professionals and pharmacy staff, this API allows for the retrieval of detailed information regarding prescription fulfillment. Use cases include monitoring prescription progress, ensuring timely medication availability, and facilitating communication between patients and healthcare providers. This resource is essential for enhancing medication adherence and optimizing patient care workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their prescriptions, providing insights into whether they are active, filled, or require attention. It is essential for managing medication adherence and understanding prescription timelines.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of prescriptions. It should include necessary parameters to specify the context of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully with the current status of prescriptions.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of prescriptions. The specific string value will define the request for the operation.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusResponse_.title: Prescription Status Response
